nvitk.measure.morpho.tree_regions
=================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure.morpho.tree_regions

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Bifurcating tree-region splitting, labeling, pruning, and exports.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: discarded_source_path_ids_from_regions(regions: List[dict]) -> set

   Union of all ``discarded_source_path_ids`` recorded across tree-region rows.


.. py:function:: remove_discarded_tree_path_outputs(discarded_path_ids: set, centerline_dir: Optional[str], centerline_radius_dir: Optional[str]) -> None

   Delete any previously-exported VTP files for paths that were merged/discarded during tree-region splitting.


.. py:function:: min_tree_arm_length_for_vessel(vessel_info: nvitk.measure.morpho.models.VesselInfo, length_scale: float = 1.0) -> float

   Minimum tree-arm length (mm) for this vessel: per-vessel/pair override, else the global default.

   The stored thresholds are calibrated on human anatomy; *length_scale* rescales
   them for other species (see ``_meta.length_scale`` in the topology JSON).


.. py:function:: ordered_terminal_path_records(tree: nvitk.measure.morpho.models.SkeletonTree, root_idx: int, terminal_indices: List[int], spacing) -> List[dict]

   Root-to-terminal path for each terminal, sorted longest-first (path processing order).


.. py:function:: tree_label_from_path_parts(parts: List[int]) -> str

   Render a branch-index path (e.g. ``[2, 1]``) as ``arm02_subarm01``-style text.


.. py:function:: tree_path_label_for_terminal(tree: nvitk.measure.morpho.models.SkeletonTree, root_idx: int, terminal_idx: int, spacing) -> Tuple[str, str]

   Branch label and numeric branch-path for the root→terminal path, ranking siblings by subtree extent.

   At each bifurcation along the path, downstream children are ranked by how far
   their farthest descendant endpoint reaches (longer subtree = lower branch index),
   so branch numbering is stable and reflects vessel size, not traversal order.


.. py:function:: branch_path_from_segment_name(segment_name: str) -> str

   Extract the dotted branch-index path from a recursive segment name (drops the leading ``S`` root marker).


.. py:function:: branch_label_from_path(branch_path: str) -> str

   Inverse of :func:`branch_path_from_segment_name`: dotted path → ``arm00_subarm00``-style label.


.. py:function:: split_bifurcating_tree_centerlines(label: int, component_id: int, vessel_info: nvitk.measure.morpho.models.VesselInfo, path_results: List[dict], spacing, region_centerline_dir: Optional[str] = None, length_scale: float = 1.0) -> Tuple[List[dict], Dict[str, pandas.DataFrame], List[dict]]

   Split a simple 2-terminal bifurcation into a shared trunk region plus two arm regions.

   Finds where the two root-to-terminal centerlines overlap (a common proximal
   trunk) using nearest-neighbor point matching, then exports the trunk and each
   arm as separate labeled regions. Only applies to exactly 2 paths — non-bifurcating
   trees (>2 terminals) are left to the recursive tree-segment splitter instead.


.. py:function:: save_labeled_tree_path_centerlines(path_results: List[dict], regions: List[dict], centerline_dir: Optional[str]) -> None

   Overwrite each original path's centerline VTP with per-point trunk/arm region labels/codes.
